name: Emergency Eye
tagline: Turns bystanders' phones into live emergency cameras with location for responders, flagging weapons with AI.
problem: Many spaces lack camera coverage, leaving responders blind during incidents such as campus shootings.
solution: Live video, audio and GPS stream to a responder dashboard with notes and AI threat detection on a map.
demo_moment: Team-described: start a stream and see it appear on the responder map.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Lovable] Best use of Lovable” among 169 submissions.

lessons: Reuse the devices people carry instead of installing new ones.
